title: Scandal
lines: The overall strength of the Scandal makes it the strongest hooking Hammer ball ever produced! What makes it so strong? Is it the new Scandal core, Semtex Solid CFI (Carbon Fiber Infused) cover?
People say symmetrical cores can’t offer this much performance. Well, we beg to differ!
Chemical Friction, blah, blah. Mechanical Friction, blah, blah. We got your friction! Our new Semtex Solid CFI (Carbon Fiber Infused) cover takes friction to a whole new level.
